text:
rachel: quick thread 1 proposing a tiny synthesis from last week's IA sessions. goal: keep canonical URLs clean, make sharing an exact "view" explicit, avoid surprise scrolls, and cover a11y. sketch: https://figma.com/file/leftrail-synth (frames).
diego: +1. prefer path segments for canonical deep links (/w/:ws/nav/:group/:item). ephemeral UI like open groups/pins should be history.state by default.
anya: agree. main UX ask: breadcrumb clicks must expand the rail and focus the item without changing the canonical path. use smooth scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }) and then announce via aria-live: "Focused on <name>".
kevin: dev note: for shareable exact views we should avoid long query strings. two low-cost options: encoded fragment (#v=...) or short server token (/nav?view=abcd). fragments are simplest for MVP, but watch PII.
anya: accessibility: when restoring a view that expands groups, emit a polite aria-live message like "Navigation restored: Teams expanded" and move focus to the primary restored item. ensure pin buttons use aria-pressed and group headers have aria-expanded + aria-controls. add SR test cases.
rachel: copy/labels: primary = "Copy link" (canonical only). secondary = "Copy exact view (includes open sections)". toast variants: "Link copied" / "Exact view copied". banner when loading exact view: "This link restores open sections" with a dismiss.
diego: implementation sketch (ephemeral state):
```
const state = { open: ['teams-42'], pinned: [] };
history.replaceState(state, '', `/w/${ws}/nav/teams/42`);
// sessionStorage fallback on full reload
```
kevin: fragment encoder sketch for copy exact view:
```
const payload = btoa(JSON.stringify({ open: ['teams-42'] }));
copy(`${location.origin}${location.pathname}#v=${payload}`);
```
annya: small a11y nit: when copying exact view include a toast that explains the link contains UI state: "Exact view copied 1 includes open sections" so users know what they're sharing. also keep focus on the copy button after action.
access-bot: a11y checklist added to docs: role=button + tabindex=0 for headers, aria-expanded, aria-controls with id pattern navgrp-<id>-list, pin = aria-pressed, live region for restore, keyboard tests included.
rachel: decision summary: 1) canonical deep links = path segments, 2) ephemeral UI = history.state + sessionStorage fallback, 3) explicit "Copy exact view" uses encoded fragment for MVP, 4) breadcrumb clicks expand + focus target with smooth scroll + aria-live announce, 5) copy strings as above, 6) subtle banner when loading exact view.
diego: i'll prototype the history.state restore and breadcrumb expand.
anya: i'll add SR test cases and update the a11y doc.
kevin: i'll build a small fragment encoder and a sanitizer to strip long/sensitive ids.
rachel: thanks team 44aa i'll update figma and post a PR checklist here.
